# SSolutions

> SSolutions is the portfolio of Strahinja Sretenović — software engineer and full-stack developer from Novi Sad, Serbia. Master's student in Electrical and Computer Engineering at the Faculty of Technical Sciences (FTN), University of Novi Sad; B.Sc. in Software and Information Technologies (FTN). One year as a Software Developer (PHP/REST/MySQL backend for a GPS Android app).

## Services
- Websites and landing pages
- Web apps and custom software (bookings, catalogues, admin panels)
- SEO and site speed
- Redesigns

## Work
- [Frizerski salon Stevan](https://frizerski-salon-stevan.vercel.app/): salon website
- [Ada Studio](https://adastudio.rs/): studio platform and CMS
- [Altara Inmo](https://www.altarainmo.com/): real-estate portal
- [Taxi Pro GPS](https://www.taxiprogps.com/): fleet tracking software
